display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
stem: 美国和欧盟的关键反金融犯罪（AFC）监管机构有哪些？它们各自承担着怎样的职责？

options.A: 美国联邦储备委员会和欧洲中央银行负责监管洗钱和制裁事项
options.B: 金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）和欧洲证券和市场管理局（ESMA）实施制裁并打击洗钱活动
options.C: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）和欧洲银行管理局（EBA）是主要负责执行反洗钱和制裁措施的机构
options.D: 美国海外资产控制办公室（OFAC）负责执行美国的制裁措施，而金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）则专注于打击洗钱活动。在欧盟，欧盟委员会制定反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义（AML/CFT）法规，由各成员国执行，并由反洗钱机构协调相关工作

stem_en: What are the key anti-financial crime (AFC) regulatory bodies in the United States and the European Union and their respective roles?

options_en.A: The U.S. Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank oversee money laundering and sanctions
options_en.B: FinCEN and ESMA issue sanctions and combat money laundering
options_en.C: The SEC and the EBA are the main bodies enforcing AML and sanctions
options_en.D: The Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) enforces U.S. sanctions, while FinCEN focuses on money laundering. In the EU, the European Commission sets AML/CFT regulations, with enforcement by member states coordinated by anti-money laundering authorities
